visible_item.prompt: Mia arrived at the office at 9:00. The cleaner came at 10:00. Complete the sentence using the verb “clean”: At 9:00, the cleaner ____ the office.
visible_item.target_answer: At 9:00, the cleaner had not cleaned the office.
